best_key:
def best_key (s : State) (l : List String) : Option String :=
  match l with
  | [] => none
  | k :: t =>
    match best_key s t with
    | none => some k
    | some b =>
      if cost s b > cost s k then some b
      else if cost s k > cost s b then some k
      else if k < b then some k else some b
best_key_ne_none:
theorem best_key_ne_none (s : State) : ∀ l : List String, l ≠ [] → best_key s l ≠ none := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h hc; exact h rfl
  | cons k t ih =>
    intro h hc
    cases hb : best_key s t with
    | none => simp [best_key, hb] at hc
    | some b =>
      simp only [best_key, hb] at hc
      by_cases h1 : cost s b > cost s k <;> simp [h1] at hc
      by_cases h2 : cost s k > cost s b <;> simp [h1, h2] at hc
      by_cases h3 : k < b <;> simp [h1, h2, h3] at hc
best_key_none:
theorem best_key_none (s : State) : ∀ l : List String, best_key s l = none → l = [] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; rfl
  | cons k t ih =>
    intro h
    cases hb : best_key s t with
    | none => simp [best_key, hb] at h
    | some b =>
      simp only [best_key, hb] at h
      by_cases h1 : cost s b > cost s k <;> simp [h1] at h
      by_cases h2 : cost s k > cost s b <;> simp [h1, h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : k < b <;> simp [h1, h2, h3] at h
best_key_spec:
theorem best_key_spec (s : State) : ∀ l : List String, ∀ k : String, best_key s l = some k →
    k ∈ l ∧ (∀ j ∈ l, cost s j ≤ cost s k) ∧ (∀ j ∈ l, cost s j = cost s k → ¬ j < k) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro k h
    simp [best_key] at h
  | cons k0 t ih =>
    intro k h
    cases hb : best_key s t with
    | none =>
      have ht : t = [] := best_key_none s t hb
      subst ht
      simp only [best_key, hb] at h
      have hk : k0 = k := Option.some.inj h
      rw [← hk]
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · omega
        · simp at hj
      · intro j hj hjc
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · exact String.lt_irrefl _
        · simp at hj
    | some b =>
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := ih b hb
      by_cases h1 : cost s b > cost s k0
      · simp only [best_key, hb, h1] at h
        have hk : b = k := Option.some.inj h
        rw [← hk]
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j hj
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
          · omega
          · exact hb2 j hj
        · intro j hj hjc
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
          · exact absurd hjc (by omega)
          · exact hb3 j hj hjc
      · by_cases h2 : cost s k0 > cost s b
        · simp only [best_key, hb, h1, h2] at h
          have hk : k0 = k := Option.some.inj h
          rw [← hk]
          refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro j hj
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
            · omega
            · have := hb2 j hj
              omega
          · intro j hj hjc
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
            · exact String.lt_irrefl _
            · have hjle := hb2 j hj
              exact absurd hjc (by omega)
        · by_cases h3 : k0 < b
          · simp only [best_key, hb, h1, h2, h3] at h
            have hk : k0 = k := Option.some.inj h
            rw [← hk]
            refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
            · intro j hj
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
              · omega
              · have := hb2 j hj
                omega
            · intro j hj hjc
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
              · exact String.lt_irrefl _
              · have hjle := hb2 j hj
                have hjb : cost s j = cost s b := by omega
                have hnot := hb3 j hj hjb
                intro hjk
                exact hnot (String.lt_trans hjk h3)
          · simp only [best_key, hb, h1, h2, h3] at h
            have hk : b = k := Option.some.inj h
            rw [← hk]
            refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb1, ?_, ?_⟩
            · intro j hj
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
              · omega
              · exact hb2 j hj
            · intro j hj hjc
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with rfl | hj
              · exact h3
              · exact hb3 j hj hjc
call_units:
def call_units (s : State) (c : Call) : Nat :=
  match price_of c.model s.prices with
  | none => 0
  | some p => c.tokens * p
cost:
def cost (s : State) (key : String) : Int :=
  Int.ofNat ((2 * total_units s key s.calls + 1000) / 2000)
keys_of:
def keys_of (l : List Call) : List String :=
  (l.map (fun c => c.key)).eraseDups
keys_of_cons_ne_nil:
theorem keys_of_cons_ne_nil (c : Call) (t : List Call) : keys_of (c :: t) ≠ [] := by
  intro hk
  have hm : c.key ∈ keys_of (c :: t) := by
    simp [keys_of, List.mem_eraseDups]
  rw [hk] at hm
  simp at hm
price_of:
def price_of (m : String) (l : List (String × Nat)) : Option Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => none
  | (m', c) :: t => if m' = m then some c else price_of m t
quota_of:
def quota_of (k : String) (l : List (String × Nat)) : Option Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => none
  | (k', q) :: t => if k = k' then some q else quota_of k t
quota_of_eq_lookup:
theorem quota_of_eq_lookup (k : String) : ∀ l : List (String × Nat), quota_of k l = List.lookup k l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    obtain ⟨k', q⟩ := hd
    by_cases h : k = k'
    · have hb : (k == k') = true := by simp [beq_iff_eq, h]
      simp [quota_of, List.lookup, h, hb]
    · have hb : (k == k') = false := by simp [beq_iff_eq, h]
      simp [quota_of, List.lookup, h, hb, ih]
quota_of_filter_ne:
theorem quota_of_filter_ne (k key0 : String) (hk : k ≠ key0) (l : List (String × Nat)) :
    quota_of k (l.filter (fun p => p.1 != key0)) = quota_of k l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    obtain ⟨k1, q1⟩ := hd
    by_cases h1 : k1 = key0
    · have hne : (k1 != key0) = false := by simp [h1, beq_iff_eq]
      have hk1 : k ≠ k1 := fun hh => hk (hh.trans h1)
      simp [List.filter, hne, quota_of, hk1, ih]
    · have hne : (k1 != key0) = true := by simp [h1, beq_iff_eq]
      simp [List.filter, hne, quota_of, ih]
record_usage:
def record_usage (s : State) (key : String) (model : String) (tokens : Nat) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  if hk : key = "" then .error "key must not be empty"
  else if hm : model = "" then .error "model must not be empty"
  else if ht : tokens = 0 then .error "tokens must be a positive number"
  else
    match quota_of key s.quotas with
    | none => add_call s key model tokens
    | some q => if hgt : s.used key + tokens > q then .error "quota exceeded" else add_call s key model tokens
set_price:
def set_price (s : State) (model : String) (cents : Nat) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  .ok (cents, { s with prices := (model, cents) :: s.prices.filter (fun p => p.1 != model) })
top_spender:
def top_spender (s : State) : Option String :=
  best_key s (keys_of s.calls)
total_units:
def total_units (s : State) (key : String) (l : List Call) : Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => 0
  | c :: t => (if c.key = key then call_units s c else 0) + total_units s key t
usage:
def usage (s : State) (key : String) : Nat :=
  s.used key
used_append_singleton:
theorem used_append_singleton (s : State) (c : Call) (k : String) :
    ({ s with calls := s.calls ++ [c] } : State).used k = s.used k + (if c.key = k then c.tokens else 0) := by
  by_cases h : c.key = k <;> simp [State.used, h, beq_iff_eq]
